answer: Allocate a marketplace's search exposure by prepaid listing time, not by a free allowance for each seller account. Every visible listing consumes one nonrefundable slot-minute from a shared ledger; renaming or moving it cannot reset the meter. If onyx divides its shop between yarrow and canyon identities, keeping all their listings visible still consumes the same total slot-minutes. An attacker must pay for the exposure it monopolizes rather than minting free storefronts. Prices must cover congestion, and wealthy buyers can still dominate.
